name: testing-will-things-work
description: Portable Claude Code skills for a local AI model (no paid Anthropic API) — /tree, /taste, and /graph

plugins.name: tree
plugins.description: Decompose a large or multi-part build into a verified task tree, split the optimal amount to finish at the best effort in the least time, and dispatch the independent pieces to subagents on your local model within its real concurrency limits.

plugins.name: taste
plugins.description: Apply practitioner judgment instead of generic-model defaults when creating or critiquing a real deliverable.

plugins.name: graph
plugins.description: Build and query a persistent, confidence-tagged knowledge graph of a repository.
